headline: Deep and unsupervised models prioritize noncoding variants by regulatory impact
label: Regulatory Variant Effect Prediction
summary: Recent work pairs DNA language models, 3D genome structure, and MPRA supervision with sequence models to refine noncoding variant prioritization.
synthesis: The common thread is inferring regulatory consequences of noncoding and somatic variants from sequence, chromatin, and multiomic context. Sequence-to-function models are being refined: Borzoi is fine-tuned on synthetic MPRA labels, raising CAGI5 and eQTL Pearson correlations, while eQIF aggregates Enformer predictions into an unsupervised per-variant gene-regulatory score. CellReg3D combines DNA language model embeddings with Hi-C 3D chromatin interactions to predict cell-type-specific regulation. mV2G integrates 24 functional genomic evidence types across 50 tissues, and a Nature Genetics framework pairs a methylation compendium spanning over 90 tissues and cell types with the Wreath model. XGBoost-SHAP on iPSC-derived pancreatic progenitor snATAC-seq prioritizes lower-frequency SNPs affecting HNF4A binding. The new elements are 3D chromatin context and MPRA-based supervision of variant-effect models.
